cover.title: the founder who hires across europe

inner.title: post the range
inner.body: since june 2026, eu rules expect a salary range in the ad or before the first interview. asking what are you on now is off the table too.
inner.label: not competitive

inner.title: learn the blue card
inner.body: the eu blue card salary threshold sits between 1 and 1.6 times average gross annual salary. denmark and ireland don't take part.
inner.label: not in dublin

inner.title: get the a1
inner.body: teleworking under 50% from abroad can keep staff insured in your country, with an a1 certificate. backdating stops at three months.
inner.label: paperwork first

inner.title: watch the 50% rule
inner.body: the oecd's 2025 update says a home used under 50% of working time generally isn't a place of business. employee convenience isn't a commercial reason.
inner.label: tax office notices

inner.title: rent an employer
inner.body: an employer of record becomes the legal employer and runs payroll and local compliance. setting up your own entity can take about five months.
inner.label: skip the notary

closer.HEADLINE:
hiring abroad is
mostly paperwork
